bounty_title: Add ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation to ChatView

changes.description: Added role='log' and aria-live='polite' to LegendList container for screen reader announcements
Added role='listitem' and tabIndex to TimelineRowContent for keyboard navigation
Added keyboard navigation hook: Arrow Up/Down between messages, Enter to expand, Escape to collapse
Added skip links for keyboard navigation to jump directly to chat messages or composer input
Added id='chat-messages' to messages wrapper for skip link target
Added id='composer-input' to input bar wrapper for skip link target

accessibility_features: Keyboard navigation: Arrow Up/Down between messages
Keyboard shortcuts: Enter to expand, Escape to collapse
Skip links for jumping to major sections
testing_notes: Tab through the interface to verify skip links appear and work
Use Arrow Up/Down keys to navigate between messages
Test with screen reader to confirm ARIA announcements
